title: unified-rollouts-add-probing-rollback-telemetry-and-safety-guards
author: Priya Kapoor
description: This PR adds additional probing telemetry and observability hooks used by the Unified Rollouts autorollback engine to improve safety and debuggability for canary/A-B/ shadow workflows. Motivation: recent incidents showed rollback decisions lacked signal richness and made post-mortem analysis harder; we need more consistent metrics that capture probing outcomes, quorum counts, and model divergence for automated rollback policies. Summary of changes: 1) emit new rollout.probe.* metrics (probe_result, probe_latency_ms, probe_quorum, probe_sample_count) from the probing service; 2) record rollback decision context in the autorollback engine so the observability pipeline can reconstruct why a rollback happened (metrics snapshot, thresholds, affected route); 3) add a lightweight tracing span around probing and decision points for end-to-end latency and flamegraph correlations; 4) add e2e test harness that simulates noisy probe signals and verifies autorollback triggers and quarantine behavior; 5) docs update describing telemetry, dashboards, and recommended alerting. Checklist: - [x] metrics emitted with stable tags (team, model, rollout_id, stage) - [x] autorollback engine records decision payload to observability store - [x] e2e and integration tests added - [x] dashboards + example alerts documented - [x] performance smoke test under synthetic traffic. Rollout plan: merge to main behind a feature flag enabled for 10% of canaries for the first 48h; validate metric volumes and false positive rates; escalate to full rollout if no regressions. Linear references: ENG-2481 (autorollback telemetry), ENG-2509 (probe stability).
commits: Record rollback_decision context in autorollback engine
Add tracing spans around probing and decision points
E2E tests: simulate noisy probes and quorum behavior
Docs: rollouts observability and example alerts
review_comments: Ethan Rodriguez: Can you clarify the cardinality of the rollout_id tag? High-cardinality could blow up cardinality in metrics backend. Reply: Priya Kapoor: rollout_id is coarse (short hashed id) and we also emit sample_rate and bucket tags; we've added a downsampling rule in the config to avoid cardinality explosion.

Maya Lin: The rollback decision payload recording looks potentially sensitive. Are we redacting any PII or prompt content? Reply: Priya Kapoor: We only record metric snapshots and route/model identifiers; prompts and user payloads are explicitly excluded. Added a unit test to assert no prompt fields are serialized.

Noah Bennett: e2e flakiness observed locally; can we add a retry/backoff in the test harness? Reply: Priya Kapoor: Added deterministic seed and limited retry for the noisy probe test, plus CI tag to run the test only in integration stage to reduce local flakiness.
Ethan Rodriguez (follow-up): Suggest adding histogram for probe_latency_ms with explicit bucket boundaries. Reply: Priya Kapoor: Added histogram buckets and updated dashboard example.

release_notes: Added rollout probing telemetry (rollout.probe.*) and recording of autorollback decision context to improve observability of canary/A-B/shadow rollouts. Includes e2e tests and dashboard examples. Rollout behind feature flag.
testing_summary: Unit + integration tests added; e2e harness simulates noisy probes and verifies quorum and quarantine behavior; performance smoke tests run on staging with synthetic traffic; observed metric ingestion within expected bounds.
notes_for_ops: Enable feature flag 'rollout.probing.telemetry' for 10% of canaries; monitor rollout.probe.quorum and rollout.rollback.decisions rate; suggested alert: trigger if rollback_decisions > 5% of canaries in 10m and probe_quorum < configured threshold. If alert fires, revert flag and open incident with telemetry snapshot attached.
